categories.access: Signing in or resetting account access.
categories.other: Anything outside these categories, or insufficient context.

policy.human_review: Required for every billing or other ticket, and every urgent ticket. All outputs are drafts. Do not send messages, alter accounts, promise availability or issue refunds.
